title: Candlesticks, OHLC and timeframes
summary: Each candle shows the open, high, low and close of one period. The timeframe sets how long that period is, from minutes to a day.
unreliableWhen: A single candle's shape says little on its own. Very short timeframes are full of noise, and a candle that has not closed yet can still change completely.
goodExample: Reading a candle as "opened at 1.1000, dipped to 1.0980, closed near its high at 1.1030" and saying which timeframe it is on.
badExample: Calling one long green candle a buy signal, or judging a candle before it has closed.

chart.lookFor: Long-press a few candles to read their open, high, low and close. Find one with a long lower wick and say what happened inside that period. Then switch timeframe and notice that each candle now covers a different length of time.
